candidates.title: All Corporations: Colorado Income Tax Credits by Size of Colorado Taxable Income
candidates.description: The types of Colorado credits claimed by all C corporations, by Colorado taxable income group.

candidates.title: All Corporations: Income and Tax Data by Industry in Colorado
candidates.description: Aggregate income and tax data for all C corporations by industry.

candidates.title: Total Revenue of Charities Operating in Colorado
candidates.description: Charitable organizations’ revenue amounts from the previous and current tax year as reported to the IRS with Form 990, provided by Colorado Department of State (CDOS) since 2011.

candidates.title: Conservation Easements for Charities Operating in Colorado
candidates.description: Types, numbers, acreage, and expenses of conservation easements held by charitable organizations as reported to the IRS in annual filings using Form 990, provided by the Colorado Department of State (CDOS) since 2011.

candidates.title: Colorado Art, Culture and Humanities Non-Profits
candidates.description: This dataset contains Non-Profits in Colorado related to Art, Culture and the Humanities. These were identified using the National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities (NTEE) code. The data contains over 2000 entries for as far back as 1922 thru present day. All of the codes in this dataset are available in the attached PDF file.

candidates.title: OpportunityZoningCertified
candidates.description: Opportunity Zones are an economic development tool that allows people to invest in distressed areas in the United States. Their purpose is to spur economic growth and job creation in low-income communities while providing tax benefits to investors. Opportunity Zones were created under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017
